source.text: לֵאמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ֩ וְהָלְכָ֨ה מֵאִתּ֜וֹ וְהָיְתָ֣ה לְאִישׁ־אַחֵ֗ר הֲיָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ ע֔וֹד הֲל֛וֹא חָנ֥וֹף תֶּחֱנַ֖ף הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְאַ֗תְּ זָנִית֙ רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְשׁ֥וֹב אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Saying: if sends away a man his wife, and she goes from him and becomes [wife] to another man, will he return to her again? Not utterly will be polluted the land the that? And you have prostituted [with] companions many; and return to me? declares Yahweh.

en.L: Saying: If a man sends away his wife, and she goes from him and becomes another man's [wife], will he return to her again? \q Would not that land be utterly defiled? \q But you have prostituted yourself with many lovers; \q and would you return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: This is the message: If a man divorces his wife, and she leaves him and marries another man, will he go back to her again? \q Would that land not be thoroughly defiled? \q Yet you have prostituted yourself with many lovers, \q and would you now come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: This is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message: Suppose a man divorces his wife, and she leaves him and marries someone else. He cannot take her back again. \q If he did, the whole land would be made unclean. \q My people, you have been unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, like a woman with many lovers. \q Do you think you can just come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Diciendo: Si un hombre despide a su mujer, y ella se va de él y llega a ser de otro hombre, ¿volverá él a ella otra vez? \q ¿No quedaría esa tierra del todo contaminada? \q Pero tú te has prostituido con muchos amantes; \q ¿y volverías a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Este es el mensaje: Si un hombre se divorcia de su mujer, y ella lo deja y se casa con otro hombre, ¿volverá él a ella otra vez? \q ¿No quedaría esa tierra completamente contaminada? \q Pero tú te has prostituido con muchos amantes, \q ¿y ahora quieres volver a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Este es el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: Supongamos que un hombre se divorcia de su mujer, y ella lo deja y se casa con otro. Él no puede volver a tomarla como esposa. \q Si lo hiciera, toda la tierra quedaría impura. \q Pueblo mío, tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has sido infiel, como una mujer con muchos amantes. \q ¿Crees que puedes volver a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} así nada más?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Disant : Si un homme renvoie sa femme, et qu’elle s’en va de chez lui et devient [la femme] d’un autre homme, reviendra-t-il encore vers elle ? \q Ce pays-là ne serait-il pas entièrement souillé ? \q Mais toi, tu t’es prostituée avec de nombreux amants ; \q et tu reviendrais vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Voici le message : Si un homme répudie sa femme, qu’elle le quitte et en épouse un autre, retournera-t-il encore vers elle ? \q Ce pays ne serait-il pas complètement souillé ? \q Et toi, tu t’es prostituée avec de nombreux amants, \q et tu voudrais maintenant revenir vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Voici le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : Imaginons qu’un homme divorce de sa femme, et qu’elle le quitte pour épouser quelqu’un d’autre. Il ne peut pas la reprendre. \q S’il le faisait, tout le pays deviendrait impur. \q Mon peuple, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as été infidèle, comme une femme qui a beaucoup d’amants. \q Crois-tu pouvoir revenir vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme si de rien n’était ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kusema: Mtu akimwacha mkewe, naye akatoka kwake akawa [mke] wa mtu mwingine, je, atamrudia tena? \q Je, nchi ile haitatiwa unajisi kabisa? \q Lakini wewe umefanya ukahaba na wapenzi wengi; \q nawe utanirudia? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ujumbe ni huu: Mtu akimpa mkewe talaka, naye akamwacha akaolewa na mtu mwingine, je, atamrudia tena? \q Je, nchi ile isingetiwa unajisi kabisa? \q Lakini wewe umefanya ukahaba na wapenzi wengi, \q nawe sasa ungetaka kunirudia? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Huu ndio ujumbe wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Tuseme mtu amempa mkewe talaka, naye amemwacha na kuolewa na mtu mwingine. Mume wa kwanza hawezi kumrudia tena. \q Akifanya hivyo, nchi yote itakuwa najisi. \q Enyi watu wangu, mmekuwa si waaminifu kwangu, kama mwanamke mwenye wapenzi wengi. \q Je, mnadhani mnaweza kunirudia tu kirahisi? anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Rằng: Nếu một người đàn ông bỏ vợ mình, và nàng rời khỏi ông mà thành [vợ] của một người đàn ông khác, thì ông ấy có trở lại với nàng nữa chăng? \q Chẳng phải xứ ấy sẽ bị ô uế hoàn toàn sao? \q Còn ngươi, ngươi đã làm điếm với nhiều tình nhân; \q mà ngươi lại trở về cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Đây là sứ điệp: Nếu một người đàn ông ly dị vợ mình, rồi nàng bỏ đi và lấy một người đàn ông khác, thì người ấy có còn trở lại với nàng nữa không? \q Như thế chẳng phải xứ ấy sẽ bị ô uế hoàn toàn sao? \q Thế mà ngươi đã làm điếm với biết bao tình nhân, \q nay ngươi lại muốn trở về cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: Giả sử một người đàn ông ly dị vợ, rồi nàng bỏ đi và lấy chồng khác. Người ấy không thể nhận nàng trở lại được nữa. \q Nếu làm vậy, cả xứ sẽ bị ô uế. \q Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, ngươi đã bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như một người đàn bà có nhiều tình nhân. \q Ngươi nghĩ rằng ngươi cứ thế mà trở về cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} được sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 말하기를, 만일 어떤 남자가 자기 아내를 내보내고, 그 여자가 그에게서 떠나 다른 남자의 [아내가] 되면, 그가 다시 그 여자에게 돌아가겠느냐? \q 그 땅이 아주 더럽혀지지 않겠느냐? \q 그런데 너는 많은 애인들과 음행했다. \q 그러고도 나에게 돌아오겠다는 것이냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 이런 말씀이다. 어떤 남자가 아내와 이혼하고, 그 여자가 그를 떠나 다른 남자와 결혼하면, 그 남자가 다시 그 여자에게 돌아가겠느냐? \q 그렇게 되면 그 땅이 온통 더럽혀지지 않겠느냐? \q 그런데 너는 많은 애인들과 음행을 했다. \q 그러고서 이제 나에게 돌아오겠다는 것이냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 말씀이다. 어떤 남자가 아내와 이혼하고, 그 여자가 그를 떠나 다른 사람과 결혼했다고 하자. 그 남자는 그 여자를 다시 데려올 수 없다. \q 만일 그렇게 하면 온 땅이 더럽혀질 것이다. \q 내 백성아, 너는 애인이 많은 여자처럼 나를 배신했다. \q 그런데도 그냥 나에게 돌아올 수 있다고 생각하느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Dizendo: Se um homem despede a sua mulher, e ela sai de junto dele e se torna [mulher] de outro homem, voltará ele para ela de novo? \q Não ficaria aquela terra totalmente contaminada? \q Mas tu te prostituíste com muitos amantes; \q e voltarias para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Esta é a mensagem: Se um homem se divorcia da sua mulher, e ela o deixa e se casa com outro homem, será que ele vai voltar para ela? \q Aquela terra não ficaria totalmente contaminada? \q Mas tu te prostituíste com muitos amantes, \q e agora queres voltar para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Esta é a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: Se um homem se divorcia da sua mulher, e ela o deixa e se casa com outro, ele não pode aceitá-la de volta. \q Se fizesse isso, a terra inteira ficaria impura. \q Meu povo, tu foste infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, como uma mulher com muitos amantes. \q Pensas que podes simplesmente voltar para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: saying: the word that usually introduces a message, here standing alone at the head of a new oracle
alternatives: a continuation of the heading at 2:1
"that is to say", tying the verse to chapter 2
decisions.reason: The verse opens with the word that normally follows "The word of the LORD came to me" (as in 2:1), but nothing comes before it here. It may be what is left of such a heading, or it may simply mark what follows as God's message. Either way the words that follow are God's, as "declares the LORD" at the end shows.

decisions.choice: the law of Deuteronomy 24:1-4: a divorced wife who has married another man may not go back to her first husband
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 24:1-4 forbids the first husband to take back a wife he has divorced once she has belonged to another man, and says that doing so would bring sin on the land. Jeremiah asks the question as anyone who knew that law would answer it: no, he will not, and the land would be defiled. Israel stands in the place of the wife, and her case is worse: she has had many lovers.

decisions.choice: prostituted yourself with many lovers: Israel's worship of other gods, pictured as a wife's unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: The covenant between the LORD and Israel is pictured as a marriage, so worshiping other gods is pictured as prostitution and adultery (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17; Hosea 2:4-7). The "lovers" are the gods Israel turned to, and perhaps also the nations whose help it sought (2:18, 36). The picture is about Israel's worship, not about the conduct of particular women.

decisions.choice: and would you return to me?: a question, spoken as a rebuke
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "and return to me", with the verb in a bare form that can be a question or a command. After the question about the divorced wife, it most likely asks how Israel can think of coming back as if nothing had happened. It can also be read as an invitation, "yet return to me", which the rest of the chapter does make (3:12, 14, 22). The verb "return" (shuv) is the chapter's key word.

decisions.choice: divorces ... marries ... prostituted yourself (B) / been unfaithful (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "sends away" and "becomes another man's"; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary words for divorce and remarriage, as Deuteronomy 24:1-2 does. Readable puts the picture of prostitution as unfaithfulness to God, as Leviticus 20:5-6 and Numbers 15:39 do.

decisions.choice: He cannot take her back again ... My people
decisions.reason: Readable gives the expected answer to the two questions as statements, and says who "you" is: the woman addressed is God's people.

decisions.choice: "despide" (L); "se divorcia ... se casa" (B, R); "te has prostituido" (L, B); "me has sido infiel" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal keeps the Hebrew verbs, Balanced names divorce and remarriage, Readable says plainly what the prostitution stands for. Israel is addressed as a woman, "tú".

decisions.choice: kunirudia
decisions.reason: Shuv is "kurudi" throughout Jeremiah, and "kunirudia" when the people turn back to God, as the terms note sets it, so that the play on "return" through chapters 3-4 is heard.

decisions.choice: "répudie" (B); "divorce" (R); "renvoie" (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the legal word of Deuteronomy 24:1-4 for sending a wife away, Readable the everyday word; Literal keeps the Hebrew verb.

decisions.choice: despede (L), se divorcia (B, R); te prostituíste (L, B), foste infiel (R)
decisions.reason: The verse takes up the divorce law of Deuteronomy 24:1-4 (m2), so Literal keeps its verb "despedir" and Balanced and Readable say "divorciar-se", as the English does. God still speaks to Israel as a woman, with "tu" (2:2); the prostitution is her worship of other gods (m3), which Readable names as unfaithfulness.

source.text: שְׂאִֽי־עֵינַ֨יִךְ עַל־שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּרְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א שֻׁכַּ֔בְתְּ עַל־דְּרָכִים֙ יָשַׁ֣בְתְּ לָהֶ֔ם כַּעֲרָבִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַתַּחֲנִ֣יפִי אֶ֔רֶץ בִּזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ וּבְרָעָתֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift your eyes to [the] bare heights and see: where not have you been lain with? By [the] roads you sat for them like an Arab in the wilderness, and you polluted [the] land with your prostitutions and with your wickedness.

en.L: Lift up your eyes to the bare heights and see: \q where have you not been lain with? \q By the roads you sat for them like an Arab in the wilderness, \q and you have defiled the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.
en.B: Look up at the bare hilltops and see: \q is there any place where you have not been lain with? \q You sat by the roadsides waiting for lovers, like a nomad in the desert, \q and you have defiled the land with your prostitution and your wickedness.
en.R: Look up at the bare hilltops. \q Is there any place where you have not been unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? \q You sat by the roads waiting for lovers, like a desert raider waiting for travelers. \q You have made the land unclean by your unfaithfulness and your evil ways.

es.L: Alza tus ojos a las alturas desnudas y mira: \q ¿dónde no te has acostado con ellos? \q Junto a los caminos te sentabas para ellos como un árabe en el desierto, \q y has contaminado la tierra con tus prostituciones y con tu maldad.
es.B: Mira hacia las colinas peladas y observa: \q ¿hay algún lugar donde no te hayas acostado con alguien? \q Te sentabas junto a los caminos esperando a tus amantes, como un nómada en el desierto, \q y has contaminado la tierra con tu prostitución y tu maldad.
es.R: Mira hacia las colinas peladas. \q ¿Hay algún lugar donde no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hayas sido infiel? \q Te sentabas junto a los caminos esperando a tus amantes, como un bandido del desierto que espera a los viajeros. \q Has hecho impura la tierra con tu infidelidad y tus malas acciones.

fr.L: Lève les yeux vers les hauteurs dénudées et vois : \q où n’as-tu pas été possédée ? \q Sur les routes tu t’asseyais pour eux comme un Arabe dans le désert, \q et tu as souillé le pays par tes prostitutions et par ta méchanceté.
fr.B: Lève les yeux vers les collines dénudées et regarde : \q y a-t-il un endroit où tu ne te sois pas livrée ? \q Tu t’asseyais au bord des chemins pour attendre tes amants, comme un nomade dans le désert, \q et tu as souillé le pays par ta prostitution et ta méchanceté.
fr.R: Regarde les collines dénudées. \q Y a-t-il un seul endroit où tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aies pas été infidèle ? \q Tu t’asseyais au bord des routes pour attendre tes amants, comme un pillard du désert qui guette les voyageurs. \q Tu as rendu le pays impur par ton infidélité et par tes mauvaises actions.

sw.L: Inua macho yako uvitazame vilele vilivyo wazi uone: \q ni wapi ambapo hukulazwa? \q Kando ya njia uliketi kuwangoja kama Mwarabu nyikani, \q nawe umeitia nchi unajisi kwa ukahaba wako na kwa uovu wako.
sw.B: Tazama juu kwenye vilele vya vilima vilivyo wazi uone: \q je, kuna mahali ambapo hukulala na wanaume? \q Uliketi kando ya njia ukingoja wapenzi, kama mhamaji jangwani, \q nawe umeitia nchi unajisi kwa ukahaba wako na uovu wako.
sw.R: Tazama juu kwenye vilele vya vilima vilivyo wazi. \q Je, kuna mahali popote ambapo hukuwa si mwaminifu kwangu? \q Uliketi kando ya njia ukingoja wapenzi, kama mnyang'anyi wa jangwani anayewangoja wasafiri. \q Umeifanya nchi kuwa najisi kwa kukosa uaminifu kwako na kwa njia zako mbaya.

vi.L: Hãy ngước mắt nhìn lên các đồi trọc mà xem: \q có nơi nào ngươi chưa bị nằm với? \q Ngươi đã ngồi bên đường chờ chúng như người Ả-rập trong hoang mạc, \q và ngươi đã làm ô uế xứ bằng sự dâm loạn và sự gian ác của ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy ngước nhìn các đỉnh đồi trọc mà xem: \q có nơi nào ngươi chưa từng nằm với tình nhân? \q Ngươi ngồi bên vệ đường chờ đợi tình nhân như người du mục trong sa mạc, \q và ngươi đã làm ô uế xứ bằng sự dâm loạn và gian ác của ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy ngước nhìn các đỉnh đồi trọc. \q Có nơi nào ngươi chưa bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không? \q Ngươi ngồi bên đường chờ tình nhân, như kẻ cướp sa mạc rình khách qua đường. \q Ngươi đã làm cho xứ ra ô uế bởi sự bất trung và những đường lối gian ác của ngươi.

ko.L: 눈을 들어 벌거숭이 언덕들을 보아라. \q 네가 몸을 더럽히지 않은 곳이 어디 있느냐? \q 너는 광야의 아라비아 사람처럼 길가에 앉아 그들을 기다렸고, \q 네 음행과 네 악으로 이 땅을 더럽혔다.
ko.B: 민둥산 꼭대기들을 쳐다보아라. \q 네가 남자와 눕지 않은 곳이 어디 있느냐? \q 너는 사막의 유목민처럼 길가에 앉아 애인들을 기다렸고, \q 네 음행과 악으로 이 땅을 더럽혔다.
ko.R: 민둥산 꼭대기들을 쳐다보아라. \q 네가 나를 배신하지 않은 곳이 한 군데라도 있느냐? \q 너는 사막의 약탈자가 나그네를 기다리듯 길가에 앉아 애인들을 기다렸다. \q 너는 네 배신과 악한 행실로 이 땅을 더럽혔다.

pt.L: Levanta os teus olhos para as alturas desnudas e vê: \q onde não foste possuída? \q Junto aos caminhos te sentavas para eles, como um árabe no deserto, \q e contaminaste a terra com as tuas prostituições e com a tua maldade.
pt.B: Olha para os topos descampados das colinas e vê: \q há algum lugar onde não foste possuída? \q Tu te sentavas à beira das estradas esperando os amantes, como um nômade no deserto, \q e contaminaste a terra com a tua prostituição e a tua maldade.
pt.R: Olha para os topos das colinas sem árvores. \q Existe algum lugar onde não foste infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}? \q Tu te sentavas à beira das estradas esperando amantes, como um assaltante do deserto à espera dos viajantes. \q Tu tornaste a terra impura com a tua infidelidade e os teus maus caminhos.

decisions.choice: where have you not been lain with: the reading the Hebrew tradition gives for this word
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell a coarser verb for sexual intercourse; the tradition of reading the text aloud replaces it with the plainer "been lain with". It does the same in Deuteronomy 28:30, Isaiah 13:16 and Zechariah 14:2. The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: bare heights: open hilltops where other gods were worshiped
decisions.reason: The word means bare, treeless heights. Hilltops were favorite places for shrines to other gods (2:20; 3:6), so the hills Israel is told to look at are the evidence against her. The same heights return in 3:21, now full of weeping.

decisions.choice: an Arab in the wilderness: a desert dweller who waits by the roads for travelers
decisions.reason: The word names a man of the desert tribes. The picture is of someone sitting by the road watching for passers-by, whether to trade with them or to rob them. Israel sat waiting for lovers just as eagerly (compare Genesis 38:14, where Tamar sits by the road).

decisions.choice: waiting for lovers ... nomad (B) / desert raider waiting for travelers (R)
decisions.reason: "Them" in the Hebrew are the lovers of 3:1, so Balanced and Readable name them. Balanced says "nomad" and Readable "desert raider" for the desert dweller, since "Arab" today calls up a modern people (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: been unfaithful to me ... unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: Readable states plainly what the picture of prostitution means: unfaithfulness to God. It keeps the reader from taking the verse as a story about one woman.

decisions.choice: as alturas desnudas (L); os topos descampados das colinas (B); os topos das colinas sem árvores (R); foste possuída (L, B)
decisions.reason: For the chapter (also verse 21; 4:11; 7:29): the bare heights (m2) keep one wording at each level, distinct from "colinas" and "montes" for the other words for hills. "Possuída", feminine, is the plain-spoken verb the reading tradition calls for (m1), said to Israel as a woman (2:2).

source.text: וַיִּמָּנְע֣וּ רְבִבִ֔ים וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ ל֣וֹא הָיָ֑ה וּמֵ֨צַח אִשָּׁ֤ה זוֹנָה֙ הָ֣יָה לָ֔ךְ מֵאַ֖נְתְּ הִכָּלֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And were withheld showers, and spring rain not has been; and [the] forehead of a woman [who is] a prostitute was to you; you refused to be ashamed.

en.L: So the showers have been withheld, \q and the spring rain has not come; \q yet you have had the forehead of a prostitute; \q you have refused to be ashamed.
en.B: So the showers have been held back, \q and the spring rain has not come. \q Yet your face is as brazen as a prostitute's; \q you will not let yourself feel shame.
en.R: That is why the showers have stopped \q and the spring rain has not come. \q But you are still as bold as a prostitute. \q You will not feel ashamed.

es.L: Por eso han sido retenidos los aguaceros, \q y la lluvia tardía no ha venido; \q pero tú has tenido frente de prostituta; \q te has negado a avergonzarte.
es.B: Por eso se han detenido los aguaceros, \q y no ha llegado la lluvia de primavera. \q Pero tienes la cara tan descarada como una prostituta; \q no quieres sentir vergüenza.
es.R: Por eso dejaron de caer los aguaceros \q y no ha llegado la lluvia de primavera. \q Pero tú sigues tan descarada como una prostituta. \q No sientes ninguna vergüenza.

fr.L: Aussi les averses ont été retenues, \q et la pluie de printemps n’est pas venue ; \q mais tu avais le front d’une prostituée ; \q tu as refusé d’avoir honte.
fr.B: Aussi les averses ont été retenues, \q et la pluie de printemps n’est pas venue. \q Mais tu as l’effronterie d’une prostituée ; \q tu refuses de ressentir la honte.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi les averses se sont arrêtées \q et la pluie de printemps n’est pas venue. \q Mais tu restes aussi effrontée qu’une prostituée. \q Tu ne veux pas avoir honte.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo manyunyu yamezuiliwa, \q wala mvua ya masika haikunyesha; \q lakini ulikuwa na kipaji cha uso cha kahaba; \q ulikataa kuona haya.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo manyunyu yamezuiliwa, \q wala mvua ya masika haikunyesha. \q Lakini uso wako hauna haya kama wa kahaba; \q unakataa kuona aibu.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu manyunyu yamekoma, \q na mvua ya masika haikunyesha. \q Lakini bado huna haya kama kahaba. \q Hutaki kuona aibu.

vi.L: Vì vậy những trận mưa rào đã bị cầm lại, \q và mưa xuân đã không đến; \q thế mà ngươi vẫn có trán của gái điếm; \q ngươi đã không chịu xấu hổ.
vi.B: Vì thế các trận mưa rào đã bị ngăn lại, \q và mưa xuân đã không đến. \q Thế mà mặt ngươi vẫn trơ trẽn như mặt gái điếm; \q ngươi chẳng chịu biết xấu hổ.
vi.R: Vì thế mưa rào đã ngừng, \q và mưa xuân đã không đến. \q Nhưng ngươi vẫn trơ tráo như một gái điếm. \q Ngươi chẳng biết xấu hổ.

ko.L: 그래서 소낙비가 그쳤고 \q 봄비가 내리지 않았다. \q 그런데도 너는 창녀의 이마를 가졌고, \q 부끄러워하기를 거절했다.
ko.B: 그래서 소나기가 멈추고 \q 봄비도 내리지 않았다. \q 그런데도 너는 창녀처럼 뻔뻔한 얼굴을 하고 \q 부끄러워할 줄을 모른다.
ko.R: 그래서 소나기가 그치고 \q 봄비가 내리지 않았다. \q 그런데도 너는 창녀처럼 뻔뻔하다. \q 너는 부끄러워하지 않는다.

pt.L: Por isso as chuvas foram retidas, \q e a chuva tardia não veio; \q contudo, tiveste a testa de uma prostituta; \q recusaste envergonhar-te.
pt.B: Por isso as chuvas foram retidas, \q e a chuva tardia não veio. \q Mas o teu rosto é descarado como o de uma prostituta; \q tu não te deixas envergonhar.
pt.R: É por isso que as chuvas pararam \q e a chuva tardia não veio. \q Mas tu continuas atrevida como uma prostituta. \q Não sentes vergonha.

decisions.choice: showers ... spring rain: the late rains of March and April that fill out the grain before harvest
decisions.reason: Israel's farming depended on the autumn rains that softened the ground and the spring rains that ripened the crops. The covenant warned that unfaithfulness would bring drought (Deuteronomy 11:13-17; 28:23-24). The drought is a sign of the broken covenant, yet Israel still does not see it.

decisions.choice: the forehead of a prostitute: a brazen, shameless face
decisions.reason: The forehead stands for the face a person shows to others. A "hard forehead" is stubborn defiance (Ezekiel 3:7-9). Israel faces God with the bold look of a woman who no longer blushes at what she does.

decisions.choice: as brazen as a prostitute's face (B) / as bold as (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the forehead means, since "forehead" alone does not carry the sense of a shameless face in English (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "l’effronterie d’une prostituée" (B); "aussi effrontée qu’une prostituée" (R)
decisions.reason: French "avoir le front de" survives as an idiom for daring, but Balanced and Readable say plainly what the picture means (m2); Literal keeps "le front".

decisions.choice: a chuva tardia
decisions.reason: The rain that ripens the grain before harvest (m1) is "a chuva tardia", the late rain of the season; "primavera" would place it in the wrong months for Brazilian readers, and "serôdia" is a word few know.

en.L: Have you not just now called to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, "My father! \q The companion of my youth [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!
en.B: Have you not just now been calling to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, "My father, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been my close friend since I was young!
en.R: Even now you call out to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, "My father! \q You have been my friend since I was young!

es.L: ¿No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has llamado ahora mismo: «¡Padre mío! \q ¡El compañero de mi juventud [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}!
es.B: ¿No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has estado llamando ahora mismo: «Padre mío, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has sido mi amigo íntimo desde que era joven!

fr.L: Ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as-tu pas appelé tout à l’heure : « Mon père ! \q Tu [es] le compagnon de ma jeunesse !
fr.B: Ne viens-tu pas de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appeler : « Mon père, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es mon ami intime depuis ma jeunesse !
fr.R: Maintenant encore, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelles : « Mon père ! \q Tu es mon ami depuis que je suis jeune !

sw.L: Je, si sasa hivi umeniita {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, "Baba yangu! \q Wewe [ndiwe] rafiki wa ujana wangu!
sw.B: Je, sasa hivi hujawa ukiniita, "Baba yangu, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umekuwa rafiki yangu wa karibu tangu ujana wangu!
sw.R: Hata sasa unaniita, "Baba yangu! \q Wewe umekuwa rafiki yangu tangu nilipokuwa kijana!

vi.L: Chẳng phải vừa mới đây ngươi đã kêu cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: "Cha tôi ơi! \q Ngài [là] bạn thuở thiếu thời của tôi!
vi.B: Chẳng phải ngay bây giờ ngươi đang kêu cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: "Cha ơi, \q Ngài là bạn thân của con từ thuở thiếu thời!
vi.R: Ngay cả bây giờ ngươi vẫn kêu lên với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: "Cha ơi! \q Cha là bạn của con từ khi con còn trẻ!

ko.L: 너는 바로 지금 나를 부르지 않았느냐? "내 아버지! \q 내 젊은 시절의 동반자는 주님이십니다!
ko.B: 바로 지금도 너는 나를 부르며 말하지 않았느냐? "내 아버지, \q 주님은 제가 어릴 때부터 가까운 벗이셨습니다!
ko.R: 지금도 너는 나를 부르며 말한다. "내 아버지! \q 주님은 제가 어릴 때부터 제 친구셨습니다!

pt.L: Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chamaste agora mesmo: "Meu pai! \q O companheiro da minha juventude [és] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}!
pt.B: Não estiveste agora mesmo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chamando: "Meu pai, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o meu amigo íntimo desde a minha juventude!
pt.R: Mesmo agora tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chamas: "Meu pai! \q Tu és o meu amigo desde que eu era jovem!

decisions.choice: have you not just now called: a reproach for words spoken in a time of trouble
alternatives: will you not from now on call to me ...?
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "yes". In the drought (3:3) the people call out to God with warm words, as if all were well between them; 3:5 shows that their deeds say otherwise. Some read "from now on" as a call to speak this way in future, but the following verse points to words already spoken.

decisions.choice: my father, the companion of my youth: the language of a daughter and of a young wife
decisions.reason: "Companion of her youth" is said of a husband in Proverbs 2:17, and the picture of the marriage continues from 3:1. "My father" looks ahead to 3:19, where God says he longed to be called this, and back to 2:27, where the people say "my father" to a piece of wood.

decisions.choice: the people's words run on into the next verse
decisions.reason: The quotation does not end with this verse: the two questions at the start of 3:5 are also the people's words.

decisions.choice: Even now you call out to me
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question that expects "yes" into a statement, which is what it means.

decisions.choice: "tu" and "toi" spoken to God take the deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: French "tu" addressed to God is a free pronoun, like the English "you", so it carries the capitalisation setting where the English has one.

decisions.choice: the people speak to God in 합쇼체 (주님, 저)
decisions.reason: Their words are an appeal to God, so Korean gives them the polite speech of prayer, though God quotes them in rebuke.

source.text: הֲיִנְטֹ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֔ם אִם־יִשְׁמֹ֖ר לָנֶ֑צַח הִנֵּ֥ה דִבַּ֛רְתְּוַתַּעֲשִׂ֥י הָרָע֖וֹת וַתּוּכָֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Will he keep [anger] forever, or will he guard [it] to [the] end? Look, you have spoken, and you have done the evil [things], and you have been able.

en.L: Will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keep [anger] forever, \q or will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} guard [it] to the end?" \q Look, you have spoken [so], but you have done evil things, and you have been able.
en.B: Will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stay angry forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hold on to it to the end?" \q That is how you talk, but you do every evil thing you can.
en.R: You will not stay angry forever, will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q You will not be angry to the end!" \q That is what you say. But you keep doing every evil thing you can.

es.L: ¿Guardará {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [su enojo] para siempre, \q o lo mantendrá hasta el fin?». \q Mira, así has hablado, pero has hecho maldades, y has podido.
es.B: ¿Seguirá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enojado para siempre? \q ¿Lo mantendrá hasta el fin?». \q Así hablas, pero haces todo el mal que puedes.
es.R: No vas a estar enojado para siempre, ¿verdad? \q ¡No estarás enojado hasta el fin!». \q Eso es lo que dices. Pero sigues haciendo todo el mal que puedes.

fr.L: Gardera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [sa colère] pour toujours, \q ou la conservera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jusqu’à la fin ? » \q Voici, tu as parlé [ainsi], mais tu as fait le mal, et tu en as été capable.
fr.B: Restera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en colère pour toujours ? \q La gardera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jusqu’au bout ? » \q Voilà comment tu parles, mais tu fais tout le mal que tu peux.
fr.R: Tu ne resteras pas en colère pour toujours, n’est-ce pas ? \q Tu ne seras pas fâché jusqu’à la fin ! » \q Voilà ce que tu dis. Mais tu continues à faire tout le mal possible.

sw.L: Je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atashika [hasira] milele, \q au ataiweka hadi mwisho?" \q Tazama, umesema [hivyo], lakini umetenda mabaya, nawe umeweza.
sw.B: Je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakaa na hasira milele? \q Je, ataishika hadi mwisho?" \q Hivyo ndivyo unavyosema, lakini unatenda kila ubaya unaoweza.
sw.R: Wewe hutakaa na hasira milele, sivyo? \q Hutakasirika hadi mwisho!" \q Hivyo ndivyo unavyosema. Lakini unaendelea kutenda kila ubaya unaoweza.

vi.L: Lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ [cơn giận] mãi mãi, \q hay canh giữ [nó] đến cùng?" \q Kìa, ngươi đã nói [như vậy], nhưng ngươi đã làm những điều ác, và ngươi đã làm được.
vi.B: Lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giận mãi sao? \q Lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ cơn giận đến cùng?" \q Ngươi nói như thế, nhưng ngươi lại làm mọi điều ác mà ngươi làm được.
vi.R: Cha sẽ không giận mãi, phải không Cha? \q Cha sẽ không giận cho đến cùng!" \q Ngươi nói như thế, nhưng ngươi cứ làm mọi điều ác mà ngươi có thể làm.

ko.L: 그분이 영원히 [진노를] 품으시겠습니까? \q 끝까지 간직하시겠습니까?" \q 보아라, 너는 [그렇게] 말하면서도 악한 일들을 저질렀고, [그렇게] 할 수 있었다.
ko.B: 그분이 영원히 노하시겠습니까? \q 끝까지 진노를 품고 계시겠습니까?" \q 너는 그렇게 말하면서도 할 수 있는 온갖 악한 일을 다 했다.
ko.R: 주님은 영원히 화를 내지는 않으시겠지요? \q 끝까지 노하지는 않으실 것입니다!" \q 너는 그렇게 말한다. 그러면서도 할 수 있는 온갖 악한 일을 계속한다.

pt.L: Guardará {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [a ira] para sempre, \q ou {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a conservará até o fim?" \q Eis que falaste [assim], mas fizeste as coisas más, e conseguiste.
pt.B: Será que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai ficar irado para sempre? \q Vai guardar a ira até o fim?" \q É assim que falas, mas fazes todo o mal que podes.
pt.R: Tu não vais ficar irado para sempre, não é? \q Não vais ficar irado até o fim!" \q É isso que dizes. Mas continuas fazendo todo o mal que podes.

decisions.choice: will he keep anger forever: words that echo God's own promise, said lightly
decisions.reason: "Keep" and "guard" are used of holding on to anger (Leviticus 19:18; Nahum 1:2), and Psalm 103:9 says of God that he will not keep his anger forever. The people use that truth as an excuse while they go on sinning. God answers the same words in 3:12: "I will not keep anger forever", but only after they acknowledge their guilt (3:13).

decisions.choice: you have done evil things, and you have been able: you did all the evil you could
decisions.reason: The last verb means "you were able, you prevailed". Joined to "you have done evil things", it says that they did evil to the full, as far as they could, while saying pious words.

decisions.choice: you have spoken: an older spelling of the form for a woman addressed
decisions.reason: The written consonants have an ending that looks like "I have spoken"; it is an older spelling of "you have spoken" (said to a woman), and the reading tradition gives the usual form. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: You will not stay angry forever, will you?
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the people speaking to God directly, as in 3:4, and turns the questions into the hopeful statements they are. In the Hebrew they speak of God as "he".

decisions.choice: "No vas a estar enojado para siempre, ¿verdad?"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the people speak to God directly; the Spanish verb carries "you" without a free pronoun, so no deity_pronoun span is needed.

decisions.choice: "Cha" for "you" in the people's words at Readable
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable turns the people's question to God into direct address, Vietnamese uses the noun "Cha" from verse 4; a noun of address takes no deity_pronoun span (style guide section 7).

fr.R: Quand Josias était roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a demandé : « As-tu vu ce qu’a fait Israël l’infidèle ? Elle est montée sur toutes les hautes collines et sous tous les arbres verts pour adorer d’autres dieux. Là, elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a été infidèle.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia katika siku za Yosia mfalme, "Je, umeona aliyoyafanya Israeli mkengeufu? Amekuwa akienda juu ya kila mlima mrefu na chini ya kila mti mbichi, naye amefanya ukahaba huko.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia wakati wa utawala wa mfalme Yosia, "Je, umeona aliyoyafanya Israeli mkengeufu? Alipanda juu ya kila kilima kirefu na kwenda chini ya kila mti mbichi, na huko alifanya ukahaba.
sw.R: Wakati Yosia alipokuwa mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniuliza, "Je, uliona aliyoyafanya Israeli mkengeufu? Alikwenda juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti mbichi kuabudu miungu mingine. Huko hakuwa mwaminifu kwangu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi trong những ngày của vua Giô-si-a: "Ngươi có thấy điều Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã làm không? Nó đã đi lên mọi đồi cao và đến dưới mọi cây xanh, và nó đã làm điếm tại đó.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi dưới triều vua Giô-si-a: "Con có thấy điều Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã làm không? Nó đã đi lên mọi đồi cao và đến dưới mọi cây xanh, và tại đó nó đã làm điếm.
vi.R: Khi Giô-si-a làm vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi tôi: "Con có thấy điều Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã làm không? Nó đã đi lên mọi đồi cao và đến dưới mọi cây xanh để thờ các thần khác. Tại đó nó đã bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 요시야 왕의 시대에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 돌아선 이스라엘이 한 일을 보았느냐? 그 여자는 높은 언덕마다 올라가고 푸른 나무 아래마다 가서 거기에서 음행했다.
ko.B: 요시야 왕이 다스리던 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "믿음을 저버린 이스라엘이 한 일을 네가 보았느냐? 그 여자는 높은 언덕마다 올라가고 푸른 나무 아래마다 가서 거기에서 음행했다.
ko.R: 요시야가 왕이었을 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 물으셨다. "믿음을 저버린 이스라엘이 한 일을 너는 보았느냐? 그 여자는 높은 언덕마다, 푸른 나무 아래마다 가서 다른 신들을 섬겼다. 그 여자는 거기서 나를 배신했다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse nos dias do rei Josias: "Viste o que Israel infiel fez? Ela ia subindo a toda colina alta e para debaixo de toda árvore verde, e ali se prostituía.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me falou durante o reinado do rei Josias: "Viste o que Israel infiel fez? Ela subiu a toda colina alta e foi para debaixo de toda árvore verde, e ali se prostituiu.
pt.R: Quando Josias era rei, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me perguntou: "Viste o que Israel infiel fez? Ela subiu a toda colina alta e foi para debaixo de toda árvore verde para adorar outros deuses. Ali ela foi infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

decisions.choice: the days of Josiah: king of Judah from about 640 to 609 BC
decisions.reason: Jeremiah began to prophesy in Josiah's thirteenth year (1:2). The northern kingdom of Israel had fallen to Assyria about a century before (2 Kings 17), and Josiah later led a reform in Judah (2 Kings 22-23). This prose section (3:6-18) speaks of the two kingdoms as two sisters.

decisions.choice: faithless Israel: Israel named for her turning away
decisions.reason: The word is a noun, "turning away" or "apostasy", used here as a name: "Turning-Away Israel". It comes from the verb shuv, "turn, return", the key word of the chapter, so the name says that Israel's whole character is to turn from God. In 3:12 God calls her by this name and tells her to turn back.

decisions.choice: every high hill and under every green tree: the places of worship of other gods
decisions.reason: The phrase is the standard description of the shrines of other gods in the hills and groves (Deuteronomy 12:2; 2 Kings 17:10; Jeremiah 2:20). Israel's "prostitution" there is the worship of those gods.

decisions.choice: faithless
decisions.reason: The name is put as an adjective, "faithless", at every level, so that it matches "faithless children" in 3:14 and 3:22, which come from the same verb. "Backsliding" is older church language and "apostate" is not an everyday word.

decisions.choice: to worship other gods. She was unfaithful to me there
decisions.reason: Readable says what Israel did on the hills, which the picture of prostitution means (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "la infiel Israel" (L, B); "Israel, la infiel" (R), feminine agreement
decisions.reason: Israel and Judah are pictured as two sisters and wives, so the adjectives and pronouns agree in the feminine, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: Israeli mkengeufu
decisions.reason: "Mkengeufu", one who has turned aside from the right way, names Israel by her turning away (meshuvah) at every level, as the English keeps "faithless"; 3:12, 14 and 22 use the same word, so the call "Rudi" sounds against it.

decisions.choice: "Israël l’infidèle", "Reviens, Israël infidèle" (3:12), "fils infidèles" (3:14, 22); "Juda la perfide"
decisions.reason: One word family at every level for *meshuvah* and *shovavim*, so that "infidèle" links the name of Israel with the "faithless children" of 3:14 and 3:22, while "revenir" carries the play on *shuv*; "perfide" names Judah's betrayal. Israel and Judah, pictured as sisters, are feminine.

decisions.choice: "Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch" (faithless Israel); "Giu-đa phản trắc" (treacherous Judah)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls Israel "Turning-Away" with the same root as "return" (shuv) in verses 12, 14 and 22. Vietnamese cannot keep the sound play; "bội nghịch" (turned against) is kept for the name at every level, as the terms note settles, and "phản trắc" names Judah's breach of faith.

decisions.choice: 돌아선 이스라엘 (Literal); 믿음을 저버린 이스라엘 (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *meshuvah* is "turning away"; Literal keeps the root of *shuv* so that the call 돌아오너라 (verse 12) can be heard against it, and Balanced and Readable say what the name means. Treacherous Judah is 배신한 유다 at every level.

decisions.choice: Israel infiel (every level), treated as feminine ("Ela")
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the name God gives the northern kingdom (m2) is "Israel infiel" at every level, with the adjective after the name, as the English keeps "faithless" at every level (r-en-1). "Infiel" is the word set for meshuvah at 2:19, so the play with "voltar" in verses 12, 14 and 22 can be followed. Israel is a sister and a wife here, so the pronouns and adjectives that refer to her are feminine ("Ela", "mais justa", verse 11).

source.text: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַחֲרֵ֨י עֲשׂוֹתָ֧הּ אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֛לֶּה אֵלַ֥י תָּשׁ֖וּב וְלֹא־שָׁ֑בָה וַתֵּ֛רֶא בָּגוֹדָ֥ה אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said: after her doing all these, to me she will return; and not she returned; and saw [it] her treacherous sister Judah.

en.L: And I said, 'After she has done all these [things], she will return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.' But she did not return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw [it].
en.B: I thought, 'After she has done all this, she will come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.' But she did not come back, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
en.R: I thought, 'After she has done all this, she will come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.' But she did not come back. And her sister Judah, who also betrayed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, saw it all.

es.L: Y yo dije: “Después de haber hecho todas estas [cosas], volverá a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”. Pero no volvió, y [lo] vio su hermana, la traidora Judá.
es.B: Yo pensé: “Después de haber hecho todo esto, volverá a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”. Pero no volvió, y su hermana, la traidora Judá, lo vio.
es.R: Yo pensé: “Después de haber hecho todo esto, volverá a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”. Pero no volvió. Y su hermana Judá, que también {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traicionó, lo vio todo.

fr.L: Et je disais : “Après avoir fait tout cela, elle reviendra vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.” Mais elle n’est pas revenue, et sa sœur, Juda la perfide, l’a vu.
fr.B: Je pensais : “Après avoir fait tout cela, elle reviendra vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.” Mais elle n’est pas revenue, et sa sœur, Juda la perfide, l’a vu.
fr.R: Je pensais : “Après avoir fait tout cela, elle reviendra vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.” Mais elle n’est pas revenue. Et sa sœur Juda, qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a trahi elle aussi, a tout vu.

sw.L: Nami nikasema, 'Baada ya kufanya [mambo] haya yote atanirudia.' Lakini hakurudi, naye dada yake Yuda msaliti akaona [hayo].
sw.B: Nilidhani, 'Baada ya kufanya hayo yote atanirudia.' Lakini hakurudi, na dada yake Yuda msaliti akaona hayo.
sw.R: Nilidhani, 'Baada ya kufanya hayo yote, atanirudia.' Lakini hakurudi. Na dada yake Yuda, ambaye pia alinisaliti, aliona hayo yote.

vi.L: Ta đã nói: 'Sau khi nó đã làm tất cả những [điều] này, nó sẽ trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.' Nhưng nó đã không trở lại, và em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa đã thấy [điều đó].
vi.B: Ta đã nghĩ: 'Sau khi làm mọi điều ấy, nó sẽ trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.' Nhưng nó đã không trở lại, và em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa đã thấy điều ấy.
vi.R: Ta đã nghĩ: 'Sau khi làm mọi điều ấy, nó sẽ trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.' Nhưng nó đã không trở lại. Và em gái nó là Giu-đa, kẻ cũng phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đã thấy tất cả.

ko.L: 나는 '그 여자가 이 모든 일을 한 뒤에는 나에게 돌아오겠지' 하고 말했다. 그러나 그 여자는 돌아오지 않았고, 그 여자의 배신한 자매 유다가 [그것을] 보았다.
ko.B: 나는 '그 여자가 이 모든 일을 한 뒤에는 나에게 돌아올 것이다' 하고 생각했다. 그러나 그 여자는 돌아오지 않았고, 배신한 그 자매 유다가 그것을 보았다.
ko.R: 나는 '그 여자가 이 모든 일을 한 뒤에는 나에게 돌아오겠지' 하고 생각했다. 그러나 그 여자는 돌아오지 않았다. 그리고 그 여자의 자매 유다도 나를 배신했는데, 그 모든 것을 보았다.

pt.L: E eu disse: 'Depois de ter feito todas estas [coisas], ela voltará para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.' Mas ela não voltou, e a sua irmã traidora, Judá, viu [isso].
pt.B: Eu pensei: 'Depois de fazer tudo isso, ela vai voltar para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.' Mas ela não voltou, e a sua irmã traidora, Judá, viu isso.
pt.R: Eu pensei: 'Depois de fazer tudo isso, ela vai voltar para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.' Mas ela não voltou. E a irmã dela, Judá, que também {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traiu, viu tudo.

decisions.choice: treacherous: one who breaks faith, especially in marriage
decisions.reason: The word describes someone who betrays a trust, and it is used of an unfaithful spouse (Malachi 2:14-16; Jeremiah 3:20). Israel is "faithless", named for turning away; Judah is "treacherous", named for betraying.

decisions.choice: and she saw: the reading tradition's form of the verb
decisions.reason: The written consonants spell the verb with an extra letter; the reading tradition gives the ordinary form "and she saw". The sense is not affected.

decisions.choice: who also betrayed me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "treacherous" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "volver"
decisions.reason: Shuv of the people turning back to God is "volver" at every level, never "arrepentirse", so the wordplay of this chapter (return, faithless) can be heard, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: msaliti
decisions.reason: "Msaliti", one who betrays, keeps the sense of breaking faith in marriage (meaning decision m1), and pairs with "kusaliti" in 3:20.

decisions.choice: traidora (Judá traidora, a sua irmã traidora)
decisions.reason: For the chapter (verses 7-11): the word for one who breaks faith in marriage (m1) is "traidora", the plain word, kept apart from "infiel", Israel's name; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. The verb in verse 20 is "trair" to match.

source.text: וָאֵ֗רֶא כִּ֤י עַל־כָּל־אֹדוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽאֲפָה֙ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁלַּחְתִּ֕יהָ וָאֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־סֵ֥פֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶ֖יהָ אֵלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֨א יָֽרְאָ֜ה בֹּֽגֵדָ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ וַתִּ֥זֶן גַּם־הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw that, for all [the] causes that committed adultery faithless Israel, I sent her away and gave [the] document of her divorce to her; and not feared treacherous Judah her sister, and she went and prostituted, also she.

en.L: And I saw that, for all the reasons that faithless Israel committed adultery, I sent her away and gave her the certificate of her divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah was not afraid, but she too went and prostituted herself.
en.B: I saw that, because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I sent her away and gave her a certificate of divorce. Yet her treacherous sister Judah was not afraid. She too went and prostituted herself.
en.R: Faithless Israel was unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in many ways. So I sent her away and gave her divorce papers. I saw that her sister, treacherous Judah, was not afraid even then. She went and was unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} too.

es.L: Y vi que, por todas las causas por las que la infiel Israel cometió adulterio, yo la despedí y le di su carta de divorcio; pero no tuvo temor su hermana, la traidora Judá, sino que fue y se prostituyó también ella.
es.B: Vi que, por haber cometido adulterio la infiel Israel, yo la despedí y le di carta de divorcio. Pero su hermana, la traidora Judá, no tuvo miedo. También ella fue y se prostituyó.
es.R: Israel, la infiel, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fue infiel de muchas maneras. Por eso la despedí y le di los papeles de divorcio. Vi que su hermana, la traidora Judá, ni siquiera entonces tuvo miedo. Ella también fue y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fue infiel.

fr.L: Et j’ai vu que, pour toutes les raisons pour lesquelles Israël l’infidèle avait commis l’adultère, je l’avais renvoyée et lui avais donné son acte de divorce ; pourtant sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’a pas eu peur, mais elle est allée se prostituer, elle aussi.
fr.B: J’ai vu que, parce qu’Israël l’infidèle avait commis l’adultère, je l’avais renvoyée et lui avais remis son acte de divorce. Pourtant sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’a pas eu peur : elle est allée, elle aussi, se prostituer.
fr.R: Israël l’infidèle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a trompé de bien des façons. Alors je l’ai renvoyée et je lui ai donné un acte de divorce. J’ai vu que sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’a même pas eu peur. Elle est allée {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tromper elle aussi.

sw.L: Nami nikaona kwamba kwa sababu zote ambazo Israeli mkengeufu alizini, nilimwacha na kumpa hati yake ya talaka; lakini dada yake Yuda msaliti hakuogopa, bali yeye naye akaenda akafanya ukahaba.
sw.B: Niliona kwamba kwa kuwa Israeli mkengeufu alikuwa amezini, nilimwacha na kumpa hati ya talaka. Lakini dada yake Yuda msaliti hakuogopa. Yeye naye alikwenda akafanya ukahaba.
sw.R: Israeli mkengeufu hakuwa mwaminifu kwangu kwa njia nyingi. Kwa hiyo nilimwacha na kumpa hati ya talaka. Nikaona kwamba dada yake, Yuda msaliti, hakuogopa hata hivyo. Alikwenda, naye pia hakuwa mwaminifu kwangu.

vi.L: Ta đã thấy rằng, vì mọi lẽ mà Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã phạm tội ngoại tình, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi nó đi và trao cho nó tờ ly dị; thế mà em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa không sợ, nhưng chính nó cũng đã đi làm điếm.
vi.B: Ta đã thấy rằng vì Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã phạm tội ngoại tình, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi nó đi và trao cho nó tờ ly dị. Thế mà em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa vẫn chẳng sợ. Chính nó cũng đã đi làm điếm.
vi.R: Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng nhiều cách. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi nó đi và trao cho nó giấy ly dị. Ta thấy rằng ngay cả khi ấy, em gái nó là Giu-đa phản trắc vẫn không sợ. Nó cũng đi và bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 나는 보았다. 돌아선 이스라엘이 간음한 그 모든 까닭으로 내가 그 여자를 내보내고 그 여자에게 이혼 증서를 주었으나, 그 여자의 배신한 자매 유다는 두려워하지 않고, 그 여자도 가서 음행했다.
ko.B: 나는 보았다. 믿음을 저버린 이스라엘이 간음했기 때문에 내가 그 여자를 내보내고 이혼 증서를 주었는데도, 배신한 그 자매 유다는 두려워하지 않았다. 그 여자도 가서 음행했다.
ko.R: 믿음을 저버린 이스라엘은 여러 가지로 나를 배신했다. 그래서 나는 그 여자를 내보내고 이혼 증서를 주었다. 그런데도 그 여자의 자매, 나를 배신한 유다는 두려워하지 않았다. 나는 그것을 보았다. 유다도 가서 나를 배신했다.

pt.L: E eu vi que, por todas as causas pelas quais Israel infiel cometeu adultério, eu a despedi e lhe dei a certidão do seu divórcio; contudo, a sua irmã traidora, Judá, não teve medo, mas foi e também ela se prostituiu.
pt.B: Eu vi que, por Israel infiel ter cometido adultério, eu a mandei embora e lhe dei um aviso de divórcio. Mesmo assim, a sua irmã traidora, Judá, não teve medo. Ela também foi e se prostituiu.
pt.R: Israel infiel foi infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} de muitas maneiras. Por isso eu a mandei embora e lhe dei um papel dizendo que ela estava divorciada. Eu vi que a irmã dela, Judá traidora, nem assim teve medo. Ela foi e também foi infiel a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

decisions.choice: I sent her away and gave her the certificate of her divorce: the steps of Deuteronomy 24:1
decisions.reason: God's dealing with northern Israel is described in the words of the divorce law Jeremiah raised in 3:1. The "divorce" is the kingdom's destruction and the exile of its people by Assyria in 722 BC (2 Kings 17:6-23). Isaiah 50:1 uses the same picture.

decisions.choice: and I saw: the Hebrew has God as the one who saw
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "I saw". A few ancient translations, such as the Syriac, read "and she saw", making Judah the one who saw what happened to Israel, as in 3:7. The Hebrew makes sense as it stands: God saw that Judah was not afraid.

decisions.choice: committed adultery: broke the marriage covenant by worshiping other gods
decisions.reason: The marriage picture continues: the adultery is Israel's worship of other gods (3:9).

decisions.choice: because faithless Israel had committed adultery (B) / unfaithful to me in many ways (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "for all the reasons that" is put as "because" at Balanced. Readable lets "all" become "in many ways" and puts the events in order, then "I saw".

decisions.choice: certidão de divórcio (L); aviso de divórcio (B); um papel dizendo que ela estava divorciada (R)
decisions.reason: The verse uses the words of the divorce law (m1), so each level takes the wording Deuteronomy 24:1 has in Portuguese at the same level.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ מִקֹּ֣ל זְנוּתָ֔הּ וַתֶּחֱנַ֖ף אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּנְאַ֥ף אֶת־הָאֶ֖בֶן וְאֶת־הָעֵֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, from [the] lightness of her prostitution, and she polluted the land; and she committed adultery with the stone and with the wood.

en.L: And because her prostitution [was] a light [thing to her], she defiled the land, and she committed adultery with stone and with wood.
en.B: Because her prostitution meant so little to her, she defiled the land, committing adultery with stone and wood.
en.R: She did not take her unfaithfulness seriously. She made the land unclean and worshiped idols of stone and wood, which was like committing adultery.

es.L: Y por la liviandad de su prostitución, contaminó la tierra, y cometió adulterio con la piedra y con el leño.
es.B: Como su prostitución le importaba tan poco, contaminó la tierra cometiendo adulterio con la piedra y con el leño.
es.R: Ella no tomó en serio su infidelidad. Hizo impura la tierra y adoró ídolos de piedra y de madera, lo cual fue como cometer adulterio.

fr.L: Et, parce que sa prostitution [était] une chose légère [pour elle], elle a souillé le pays, et elle a commis l’adultère avec la pierre et avec le bois.
fr.B: Comme sa prostitution comptait si peu pour elle, elle a souillé le pays et commis l’adultère avec la pierre et le bois.
fr.R: Elle n’a pas pris son infidélité au sérieux. Elle a rendu le pays impur, et elle a adoré des idoles de pierre et de bois : c’était comme un adultère.

sw.L: Na kwa sababu ukahaba wake [ulikuwa] jambo jepesi [kwake], aliitia nchi unajisi, naye akazini na jiwe na mti.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa ukahaba wake haukuwa na maana kwake, aliitia nchi unajisi, akizini na mawe na miti.
sw.R: Hakuuchukulia kwa uzito ukosefu wake wa uaminifu. Aliifanya nchi kuwa najisi, akaabudu sanamu za mawe na za miti, jambo lililokuwa kama kuzini.

vi.L: Vì sự làm điếm của nó [là điều] nhẹ [đối với nó], nó đã làm ô uế xứ, và phạm tội ngoại tình với đá và với gỗ.
vi.B: Vì nó xem sự dâm loạn của mình là chuyện nhỏ, nó đã làm ô uế xứ, phạm tội ngoại tình với đá và gỗ.
vi.R: Nó không coi sự bất trung của mình là nghiêm trọng. Nó đã làm cho xứ ra ô uế và thờ lạy các thần tượng bằng đá và gỗ, như thể phạm tội ngoại tình vậy.

ko.L: 그 여자의 음행이 [그 여자에게] 가벼운 [일이었으므로] 그 여자는 이 땅을 더럽혔고, 돌과 나무와 간음했다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 자기의 음행을 대수롭지 않게 여겨 이 땅을 더럽혔고, 돌과 나무를 섬기며 간음했다.
ko.R: 그 여자는 자기의 배신을 가볍게 여겼다. 그 여자는 이 땅을 더럽혔고, 돌과 나무로 만든 우상들을 섬겼다. 그것은 간음하는 것과 같았다.

pt.L: E, porque a sua prostituição [era coisa] leve [para ela], ela contaminou a terra e cometeu adultério com a pedra e com a madeira.
pt.B: Como a sua prostituição significava tão pouco para ela, ela contaminou a terra, cometendo adultério com pedra e madeira.
pt.R: Ela não levou a sério a sua infidelidade. Tornou a terra impura e adorou ídolos de pedra e de madeira, o que era como cometer adultério.

decisions.choice: the lightness of her prostitution: she treated it as a small thing
decisions.reason: The noun means lightness, the opposite of weight or seriousness. Her unfaithfulness meant little to her. Some read a related word, "noise" or "report", but "lightness" fits the charge.

decisions.choice: she defiled the land: the verb with an object
decisions.reason: This verb usually means "be defiled", but here it has an object, "the land", so the sense is that she defiled it (compare 3:1-2). Who "she" is is left open: the verse may still speak of Israel, whose story 3:6-8 tells, or of Judah, named last. The verse holds for both.

decisions.choice: stone and wood: idols and sacred objects of the other gods
decisions.reason: Standing stones and wooden poles or images stood at the shrines of other gods (Deuteronomy 16:21-22). Jeremiah mocks the people for calling a piece of wood "my father" and a stone "you gave me birth" (2:27).

decisions.choice: worshiped idols of stone and wood, which was like committing adultery
decisions.reason: Readable says what the adultery with stone and wood was, the worship of idols (meaning decision m3), and keeps the picture as a comparison.

source.text: וְגַם־בְּכָל־זֹ֗את לֹא־שָׁ֨בָה אֵלַ֜י בָּגוֹדָ֧ה אֲחוֹתָ֛הּ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּכָל־לִבָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י אִם־בְּשֶׁ֖קֶר נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And also in all this not returned to me her treacherous sister Judah with all her heart, but only in falsehood, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And even so, for all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all her heart, but only in pretense, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Even after all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} wholeheartedly; it was only a pretense, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Even after all this, her sister, treacherous Judah, did not truly come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. She only pretended to, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y aun con todo esto, su hermana, la traidora Judá, no volvió a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} de todo su corazón, sino solo con engaño, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Aun después de todo esto, su hermana, la traidora Judá, no volvió a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} de todo corazón; fue solo un engaño, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Aun después de todo esto, su hermana, la traidora Judá, no volvió a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} de verdad. Solo fingió hacerlo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et même malgré tout cela, sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’est pas revenue vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout son cœur, mais seulement en mensonge, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Même après tout cela, sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’est pas revenue vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout son cœur ; ce n’était que mensonge, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Même après tout cela, sa sœur, Juda la perfide, n’est pas vraiment revenue vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Elle a seulement fait semblant, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Na hata hivyo, pamoja na hayo yote, dada yake Yuda msaliti hakunirudia kwa moyo wake wote, ila kwa unafiki tu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Hata baada ya hayo yote, dada yake Yuda msaliti hakunirudia kwa moyo wake wote; ulikuwa unafiki tu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Hata baada ya hayo yote, dada yake, Yuda msaliti, hakunirudia kwa kweli. Alijifanya tu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Dù vậy, trong mọi điều này, em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa đã không trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với cả lòng mình, mà chỉ giả dối, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.B: Dù sau mọi điều ấy, em gái phản trắc của nó là Giu-đa vẫn không hết lòng trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; nó chỉ giả vờ mà thôi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy."
vi.R: Dù sau mọi điều ấy, em gái nó là Giu-đa phản trắc vẫn không thật lòng trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nó chỉ giả vờ thôi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán."

ko.L: 이 모든 일에도 불구하고 그 여자의 배신한 자매 유다는 온 마음으로 나에게 돌아오지 않고 거짓으로만 [돌아왔다]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 이 모든 일이 있은 뒤에도 배신한 그 자매 유다는 온 마음으로 나에게 돌아오지 않았다. 겉으로만 돌아오는 척했을 뿐이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 이 모든 일이 있은 뒤에도 그 여자의 자매, 나를 배신한 유다는 진심으로 나에게 돌아오지 않았다. 돌아오는 척만 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

pt.L: E, mesmo assim, apesar de tudo isto, a sua irmã traidora, Judá, não voltou para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} de todo o seu coração, mas só com fingimento, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.B: Mesmo depois de tudo isso, a sua irmã traidora, Judá, não voltou para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} de todo o coração; foi só fingimento, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Mesmo depois de tudo isso, a irmã dela, Judá traidora, não voltou para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} de verdade. Ela só fingiu, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

decisions.choice: in falsehood: a return that was only outward
decisions.reason: The word means a lie or a deception. Judah made a show of turning back to God, but her heart was not in it. In the setting of Josiah's days (3:6) this may point to the people's response to his reform (2 Kings 22-23), which did not change their hearts; the verse itself does not say so.

decisions.choice: with all her heart: the return God asks for
decisions.reason: To return "with all the heart" is the language of Deuteronomy for real repentance (Deuteronomy 4:29; 30:10). God measures the return by the heart, not by outward signs. The same words are said of Josiah himself in 2 Kings 23:25.

decisions.choice: did not truly come back ... She only pretended to
decisions.reason: Readable puts "with all her heart" as "truly" and "in falsehood" as pretending.

decisions.choice: "en mensonge" (L); "ce n’était que mensonge" (B); "fait semblant" (R)
decisions.reason: *Sheqer* is "le mensonge" at Literal and Balanced through the book; Readable says what the false return was.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י צִדְּקָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבֹּגֵדָ֖ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me: has shown righteous her soul faithless Israel more than treacherous Judah.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Faithless Israel has shown herself less guilty than treacherous Judah.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, "Faithless Israel was not as guilty as treacherous Judah.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «La infiel Israel se ha mostrado más justa que la traidora Judá.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «La infiel Israel ha resultado menos culpable que la traidora Judá.
es.R: Luego {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: «Israel, la infiel, no fue tan culpable como Judá, la traidora.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « Israël l’infidèle s’est montrée plus juste que Juda la perfide.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dit : « Israël l’infidèle s’est montrée moins coupable que Juda la perfide.
fr.R: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : « Israël l’infidèle était moins coupable que Juda la perfide.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Israeli mkengeufu amejionyesha kuwa mwenye haki kuliko Yuda msaliti.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Israeli mkengeufu amejionyesha kuwa na hatia ndogo kuliko Yuda msaliti.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, "Israeli mkengeufu hakuwa na hatia kubwa kama Yuda msaliti.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã tỏ ra công chính hơn Giu-đa phản trắc.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch đã tỏ ra ít tội hơn Giu-đa phản trắc.
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: "Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch không đáng trách bằng Giu-đa phản trắc.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "돌아선 이스라엘이 배신한 유다보다 자신을 더 의롭게 드러냈다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "믿음을 저버린 이스라엘이 배신한 유다보다 죄가 덜하다.
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. "믿음을 저버린 이스라엘은 나를 배신한 유다만큼 죄가 크지 않다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Israel infiel mostrou-se mais justa do que Judá traidora.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Israel infiel se mostrou menos culpada do que Judá traidora.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: "Israel infiel não foi tão culpada quanto Judá traidora.

decisions.choice: has shown herself more righteous than: is less in the wrong than
decisions.reason: The verb means "be in the right" and, in this form, "show to be in the right". Set beside Judah, Israel comes out better: not innocent, but less guilty. Judah had Israel's fall before her eyes and still did not turn back (3:7-10). Ezekiel 16:51-52 makes the same comparison, and Genesis 38:26 uses the same kind of saying ("she is more in the right than I").

decisions.choice: herself: literally "her soul"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "her soul" (nefesh), which here, as often, stands for the person herself.

decisions.choice: less guilty
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "less guilty" so that no reader takes "more righteous" as praise of Israel (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew's "more righteous".

source.text: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְקָֽרָאתָ֩ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה צָפ֗וֹנָה וְ֠אָמַרְתָּ שׁ֣וּבָה מְשֻׁבָ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה לֽוֹא־אַפִּ֥יל פָּנַ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־חָסִ֤יד אֲנִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א אֶטּ֖וֹר לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Go and proclaim these words toward [the] north and say: return, faithless Israel, declares Yahweh; not I will make fall my face on you, for loyal [am] I, declares Yahweh; not I will keep [anger] forever.

en.L: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, 'Return, faithless Israel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I will not make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face fall on you, for I [am] loyal, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I will not keep [anger] forever.
en.B: Go and proclaim this message toward the north: 'Return, faithless Israel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will not look on you in anger, for I am loyal in love, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will not stay angry forever.
en.R: Go and announce this message toward the north, where the people of Israel were taken: 'Come back, faithless Israel, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will not look at you in anger. My love is faithful, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will not stay angry forever.

es.L: Ve y proclama estas palabras hacia el norte, y di: “Vuelve, infiel Israel, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; no haré caer {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro sobre ti, porque leal [soy] yo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; no guardaré [mi enojo] para siempre.
es.B: Ve y proclama este mensaje hacia el norte: “Vuelve, infiel Israel, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No te miraré con enojo, porque soy leal en el amor, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No seguiré enojado para siempre.
es.R: Ve y anuncia este mensaje hacia el norte, adonde se llevaron al pueblo de Israel: “Regresa, Israel infiel, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No te miraré con enojo. Soy fiel en mi amor, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No seguiré enojado para siempre.

fr.L: Va, et crie ces paroles vers le nord, et dis : “Reviens, Israël infidèle, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; je ne ferai pas tomber {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face sur vous, car je [suis] fidèle, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; je ne garderai pas [{{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère] pour toujours.
fr.B: Va crier ce message vers le nord : “Reviens, Israël infidèle, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je ne vous regarderai pas avec colère, car je suis fidèle dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je ne resterai pas en colère pour toujours.
fr.R: Va annoncer ce message vers le nord, là où les Israélites ont été emmenés : “Reviens, Israël infidèle, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je ne vous regarderai pas avec colère. Mon amour est fidèle, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je ne resterai pas en colère pour toujours.

sw.L: Nenda ukatangaze maneno haya kuelekea kaskazini, useme, 'Rudi, Israeli mkengeufu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; sitauangusha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yako, kwa maana mimi [ni] mwaminifu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; sitashika [hasira] milele.
sw.B: Nenda ukatangaze ujumbe huu kuelekea kaskazini: 'Rudi, Israeli mkengeufu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sitakutazama kwa hasira, kwa maana mimi ni mwaminifu katika upendo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sitakaa na hasira milele.
sw.R: Nenda ukatangaze ujumbe huu kuelekea kaskazini, kule walikopelekwa watu wa Israeli: 'Rudi, Israeli mkengeufu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sitakutazama kwa hasira. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ni wa uaminifu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sitakaa na hasira milele.

vi.L: Hãy đi và công bố những lời này về phía bắc, và nói: 'Hãy trở lại, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không để mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sa sầm trên ngươi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] Đấng thành tín, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không giữ [cơn giận] mãi mãi.
vi.B: Hãy đi và công bố sứ điệp này về phía bắc: 'Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch, hãy trở lại, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Ta sẽ không nhìn con với cơn giận, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giàu lòng thương yêu thành tín, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Ta sẽ không giận mãi mãi.
vi.R: Hãy đi và loan báo sứ điệp này về phía bắc, nơi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã bị bắt đến: 'Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên bội nghịch, hãy ăn năn quay về, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ không nhìn con với cơn giận nữa. Tình yêu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là thành tín, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ không giận mãi mãi.

ko.L: 가서 북쪽을 향해 이 말들을 외쳐 말하여라. '돌아오너라, 돌아선 이스라엘아. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 내 얼굴을 너에게 떨어뜨리지 않겠다. 나는 신실하기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 영원히 [진노를] 품지 않겠다.
ko.B: 가서 북쪽을 향해 이 말을 외쳐라. '믿음을 저버린 이스라엘아, 돌아오너라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 노한 얼굴로 너를 보지 않겠다. 나는 한결같은 사랑을 지키기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 영원히 노하지는 않겠다.
ko.R: 가서 이스라엘 백성이 끌려간 북쪽을 향해 이 말을 알려라. '믿음을 저버린 이스라엘아, 돌아오너라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 노한 얼굴로 너를 보지 않겠다. 내 사랑은 변함이 없다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 영원히 화를 내지는 않겠다.

pt.L: Vai e proclama estas palavras para o norte, e dize: 'Volta, Israel infiel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; não farei cair o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto sobre ti, pois eu [sou] leal, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; não guardarei [a ira] para sempre.
pt.B: Vai e proclama esta mensagem em direção ao norte: 'Volta, Israel infiel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Não olharei para ti com ira, pois sou leal no amor, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Não ficarei irado para sempre.
pt.R: Vai e anuncia esta mensagem em direção ao norte, para onde o povo de Israel foi levado: 'Volta, Israel infiel, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Não vou olhar para ti com ira. O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} amor é fiel, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Não vou ficar irado para sempre.

decisions.choice: return, faithless Israel: a play on words, "turn back, Turning-Away Israel"
decisions.reason: The command and the name come from the same verb, shuv: "Return, Turning-Away". The one whose name is turning away is called to turn back, and the play runs through the chapter (3:1, 7, 10, 14, 22; 4:1). The name is explained at 3:6.

decisions.choice: toward the north: toward the lands where northern Israel had been taken in exile
decisions.reason: Assyria had deported the people of the northern kingdom to the north and east (2 Kings 17:6). The message is sent to them, though they are far away.

decisions.choice: I will not make my face fall on you: I will not look on you in anger
decisions.reason: A fallen face is an angry or displeased face (Genesis 4:5-6). God promises not to turn a hostile look on his people.

decisions.choice: loyal: one who keeps faith and shows loyal love
decisions.reason: The word is related to hesed, the loyal love that keeps a covenant. God's reason for not keeping his anger is his own character. It answers the people's careless question in 3:5 with the same verb, "keep".

decisions.choice: the message to proclaim runs on through 3:18
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not mark where the words Jeremiah is to proclaim end. They are taken here to run to the end of 3:18, since 3:13-18 go on speaking to the same people about their return.

decisions.choice: loyal in love (B) / My love is faithful (R)
decisions.reason: The word is put as "loyal in love" at Balanced and as faithful love at Readable, matching the wording for hesed (meaning decision m4). "Return, faithless Israel" cannot keep the Hebrew pun (meaning decision m1); "faithless" gives the sense of the name, as in 3:6.

decisions.choice: where the people of Israel were taken
decisions.reason: Readable says why the message goes north (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "Vuelve, infiel Israel" (L, B); "Regresa, Israel infiel" (R)
decisions.reason: The call as the terms note sets it for Spanish; "volver" and "infiel" keep the play between turning back and turning away as nearly as Spanish can.

decisions.choice: "Reviens, Israël infidèle"
decisions.reason: "Revenir" for *shuv* at every level, for repentance and return from exile alike; the name "infidèle" cannot echo the verb in French, so the English meaning decision carries the play.

decisions.choice: "trở lại" (Literal, Balanced); "ăn năn quay về" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for shuv as repentance. Here it plays on the name "bội nghịch" (meshuvah, turned away): "Turn back, you who turned away"; the play cannot be kept in Vietnamese (see 3:6).

decisions.choice: 돌아오다 for *shuv* at every level
decisions.reason: Coming back to God, and coming back from exile, is 돌아오다 at every level, keeping the Hebrew's play with "turning away"; 회개하다 stays for the Greek of the New Testament.

decisions.choice: Volta, Israel infiel (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the call (m1) is "Volta", the "tu" imperative, since God speaks to Israel as one woman (2:2), and "Israel infiel" as in verse 6; Readable keeps the same words, where the English Readable says "Come back", so that the call is heard alike through the book. Portuguese cannot keep the Hebrew play of "turn back" and "turned away" from one root, but "voltar" (verses 12, 14, 22) and "infiel" are each kept for their word; the meaning note explains the play. Verses 14 and 22, said to the people as a group, are "Voltem".

decisions.choice: leal (L); leal no amor (B); O meu amor é fiel (R)
decisions.reason: The word is related to hesed (m4), so each level uses the words set for it at 2:2: "leal" at Literal and Balanced, "fiel" at Readable.

source.text: אַ֚ךְ דְּעִ֣י עֲוֺנֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י בַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖יִךְ פָּשָׁ֑עַתְּ וַתְּפַזְּרִ֨י אֶת־דְּרָכַ֜יִךְ לַזָּרִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת כָּל־עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן וּבְקוֹלִ֥י לֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only know your iniquity, that against Yahweh your God you rebelled, and you scattered your ways to strangers under every tree green, and to my voice not you listened, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have rebelled against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and have scattered your ways to strangers under every green tree, and you have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Only admit your guilt: you have rebelled against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, you have run here and there to foreign gods under every green tree, and you have not obeyed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Just admit that you have sinned. You turned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. You gave yourself to foreign gods under every green tree. You did not obey {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Solamente reconoce tu iniquidad, que contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te rebelaste, y esparciste tus caminos hacia los extraños debajo de todo árbol frondoso, y {{plural_you:no han escuchado|no habéis escuchado}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Solo reconoce tu culpa: te rebelaste contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, corriste de aquí para allá tras dioses extranjeros debajo de todo árbol frondoso, y {{plural_you:no han obedecido|no habéis obedecido}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Solo admite que has pecado. Te pusiste en contra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios. Te entregaste a dioses extranjeros debajo de cada árbol verde. {{plural_you:Ustedes no|Vosotros no}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Seulement, reconnais ta faute : tu t’es révoltée contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, tu as dispersé tes chemins vers les étrangers sous tout arbre vert, et vous n’avez pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Reconnais seulement ta faute : tu t’es révoltée contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, tu as couru de tous côtés vers des dieux étrangers sous tout arbre vert, et vous n’avez pas obéi à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Reconnais simplement que tu as péché. Tu t’es révoltée contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Tu t’es donnée à des dieux étrangers sous tous les arbres verts. Vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas obéi, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ila ujue uovu wako, kwamba umemwasi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na umetawanya njia zako kwa wageni chini ya kila mti mbichi, wala hamkuisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ila ukiri hatia yako: umemwasi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, umekimbia huku na huko kwa miungu ya kigeni chini ya kila mti mbichi, wala hamkuitii sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kiri tu kwamba umetenda dhambi. Ulimwasi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Ulijitoa kwa miungu ya kigeni chini ya kila mti mbichi. Hamkunitii, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Chỉ hãy nhận biết tội ác của ngươi, rằng ngươi đã phản nghịch {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, và đã tản mác đường lối ngươi cho những kẻ lạ dưới mọi cây xanh, và các ngươi đã không nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Chỉ cần nhận tội của con: con đã phản nghịch {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, con đã chạy đây chạy đó theo các thần ngoại bang dưới mọi cây xanh, và các ngươi đã không vâng theo tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Con chỉ cần nhận rằng con đã phạm tội. Con đã chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con. Con đã hiến mình cho các thần ngoại bang dưới mọi cây xanh. Các ngươi đã không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 오직 네 죄악을 인정하여라. 네가 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 거역했고, 푸른 나무 아래마다 낯선 자들에게 네 길을 흩뜨렸고, 내 목소리를 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 오직 네 죄를 인정하여라. 너는 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 거역했고, 푸른 나무 아래마다 이리저리 낯선 신들을 찾아다녔고, 내 목소리에 순종하지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 네가 죄를 지었다는 것만 인정하여라. 너는 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 거역했다. 너는 푸른 나무 아래마다 다른 나라 신들에게 몸을 바쳤다. 너는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Somente reconhece a tua iniquidade: que te rebelaste contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, e espalhaste os teus caminhos para os estrangeiros debaixo de toda árvore verde, e vocês não deram ouvidos à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Apenas admite a tua culpa: tu te rebelaste contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, correste de um lado para o outro atrás de deuses estrangeiros debaixo de toda árvore verde e não obedeceste à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Apenas admite que pecaste. Tu te voltaste contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus. Tu te entregaste a deuses estrangeiros debaixo de toda árvore verde. Tu não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} obedeceste, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: acknowledge: know and admit
decisions.reason: "Know" here means to recognize one's guilt and own it. This is the one condition God sets for the return he offers: not ceremonies, but honest admission.

decisions.choice: scattered your ways to strangers: went this way and that after foreign gods
decisions.reason: To "scatter your ways" is to run off in many directions. The "strangers" are foreign gods, the lovers of 3:1-2, as in 2:25 ("I have loved strangers").

decisions.choice: you have not listened: the address changes from one woman to many people
decisions.reason: Until here "you" is one woman, Israel. The last verb is plural, and from 3:14 God speaks to the people as a group.

decisions.choice: run here and there to foreign gods (B) / gave yourself to foreign gods (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the idiom and name the strangers as foreign gods (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: hamkuisikiliza / hamkuitii (plural)
decisions.reason: The last verb turns from the woman addressed to the people in the plural (meaning decision m3); Swahili shows the change in the verb prefix "ham-".

decisions.choice: "vous n’avez pas écouté" after "tu"
